text:
sarah: FYI: just did a smoke load of vendor model 'gpt-l-v2' on staging. Some prompts return weird non-UTF8 symbols / repeated tokens. Not full OOM but bad outputs. Anyone on-call for onboarding?
alex: I'm looking. Where are the weights located (S3 path)?
sarah: s3://redwood-models/vendor/gpt-l-v2/2026-03-15/weights.tar.lz4 and there's a separate tokenizers/ folder
mika: Could be tokenizer mismatch. Vendor says SentencePiece + custom byte normalization. Did we switch to our byte-BPE fallback?
chen: @mika we have tokenizer config in model manifest: `tokenizer: sentencepiece`, `normalization: vendor_nfc`. But I remember we have a stanza that rewrites `charset: utf8` -> maybe clobbers vendor normalization
alex: Can someone paste the manifest and the quickstart loader args? I'll test locally
sarah: Manifest snippet:
```json
{
  "name":"gpt-l-v2",
  "tokenizer": "sentencepiece",
  "tokenizer_path": "tokenizers/spm.model",
  "normalization": "vendor_nfc",
  "weights_path": "weights/part-000"
}
```
chen: Loader command used in staging:
`./serve --model-manifest /mnt/models/gpt-l-v2/manifest.json --quantize none --tokenizer-mode auto`
We usually set `--tokenizer-mode vendor` for vendor normalizations but staging uses auto
mika: :eyes: that `auto` falls back to our byte-BPE if it can't detect config. Could explain repeated tokens if token boundaries differ.
alex: Quick try: will re-run loader with `--tokenizer-mode vendor` and `--tokenizer-path tokenizers/spm.model`. Ping when done.
infra-bot: deploy: started model load job id=ml-2234 on staging-node-7
alex: load finished: model loaded but initial perplexity on eval prompts improved. The bad symbols are gone for english prompts. Non-latin prompts still show odd tokenization.
sarah: Good. For non-latin tests which ones still failing?
alex: Japanese and emojis. Example: prompt '今日はいい天気ですね😊' -> output splits emoji as separate unknown tokens: `<unk> <eos>` etc.
mika: Probably vendor's normalization maps emoji sequences differently. I opened a ticket with vendor (VND-129).
chen: Temporary mitigation: enable our prefix-KV fallback and use lightweight detokenization postprocess to rejoin stray codepoints? Not ideal.
sarah: For rollout: let's hold canary until VND-129 resolved. Action items: alex update loader config to `--tokenizer-mode vendor` in staging template; chen add alert if tokenization mismatch rate > 1% on eval prompt set; mika follow up vendor.
alex: On it. I'll push PR to infra: `infra/serving: update tokenizer-mode default for vendor models` — link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/412
mika: :thumbsup: adding vendor contact and docs to model manifest checklist. Also adding small test in onboarding CI that runs multilingual sample prompts.
sarah: Thanks all. Closing for now, re-open if new regression. :white_check_mark:
